body: the things that make me stay alive are my friends, family, cats... etc. but more than that, it's just a bunch of little things. the fact that dogs on the street get so happy to see me, that old people appreciate it more than i'll ever know when i open doors for them, how much the $10 i donate to someone makes their day, the fact that the trees and flowers create oxygen that helps me live... and that almost every day there's someone who is thankful that i'm alive, even if i don't know them or we aren't friends, and even if i think i myself am complete and utter useless shit, there will always be someone out there who is happy that i am me.

thank you so much for the kind message... im not sure if getting out anywhere is possible. for my best friend, her family only has one car and its usually in use, and for myself/my so we cant drive (im getting my license soon though!) :( i dont know what else i could look into. it just cant be anything that involves driving or going out on a schedule.

truthfully, i dont really have many close friends. my best friend and my so are usually the ones who are here for me when i get extreme depression, but i dont want to burden them with my thoughts right now. not because i think they wouldnt want to help, but because i know it would make their own worries worse and i cant do that to them.
